jobs.description:
Technical Project Manager - IT Application Decommissioning Programme

Overview: We are seeking a skilled Technical Project Manager to lead the IT Application Decommissioning Programme. The ideal candidate will have over 10 years of experience in project management, specifically in application decommissioning and application portfolio management. Hands on experience with LeanIX is essential to drive the decommissioning process effectively.

Main Responsibilities

• Drive the IT Application Decommissioning Programme.

• Utilize LeanIX and its meta-model to support the decommissioning process.

• Coordinate stakeholders across both Business and IT.

• Support delivery leads across multiple workstreams.

• Track programme progress and activities in LeanIX.

• Prepare management reporting and progress updates.

• Promote the adoption and best practices of LeanIX throughout the organization.

Key Requirements

• 10+ years' experience as a Technical Project Manager.

• Significant experience with application decommissioning, application portfolio management, or similar transformation initiatives.

• Hands-on experience with LeanIX.

• Proven skills in managing stakeholders across business and IT.

• Strong capabilities in reporting, governance, and programme coordination.

• Experience managing multiple workstreams simultaneously.

Nice to Have

• Experience with IT transformation and enterprise architecture.

• Knowledge of migration and retirement programmes.

• Familiarity with SaaS portfolio rationalization.

**Other Details

**Location: onsite at greater Copenhagen

Allocation: 30 hours per week

Start date: ASAP

End date: 31 March 2027

jobs.occupation: Manager - Business Advisory and Project Management
jobs.description:
Drive meaningful impact across the life sciences industry.

As our next Manager - Business Advisory and Project Management, you will contribute to solving meaningful challenges across the life sciences industry. We offer specialised management consulting services, working with top-tier life sciences companies as well as biotech startups -locally and globally. From strategy development to hands-on implementation, we support our clients were impact matters most.

About the role

As a Manager - Business Advisory and Project Management, you will work closely with clients and colleagues to address complex challenges across the life sciences value chain. You will take ownership of your work and contribute to delivering solutions that create real, lasting impact. This is a Senior role designed to provide project and program leadership to deliver strategic technical solutions that address complex client issues in the Life Sciences industry. You will be handling implementation/migration projects and programs to achieve desired outcomes and ensure successful business growth. You will also seek new business opportunities to help BASE life science grow its presence within existing and new customers.

Additionally, you will contribute to internal initiatives and training to further strengthen BASE life science’s project and program management methodologies, approach, and tools.

You will lead teams consisting of multiple workstreams, which could include BASE/Infosys, external third party, or client stakeholders. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in, project/program management and the ability to translate business requirements into technical specifications.

Your responsibilities include:

• Developing responses to Requests for Proposals (RfPs), ensuring adequate planning for scope, timelines and budget

• Monitoring project/program status including milestones, risks, issues, budgets, etc.

• Acting as a delivery escalation point and proactively ensuring escalations are handled promptly with a clear action and communication plan.

• Creating and delivering tailored communication based on audience, i.e., executive level summaries for client stakeholders, or senior executives in BASE life science, status reports at a project or program-level at a suitable cadence for team members

• Intervening, when necessary, to ensure costs, timelines and quality are on track.

• Lead a cross-functional team to deliver projects/programs to the required scope, on time, within budget, and to the satisfaction of our life science industry stakeholders.

• Collaborate with business stakeholders in the life science industry to understand their needs and translate them into executable plans for the project team.

• Develop plans, timelines, and budgets for projects/programs for which you are responsible.

• Track and report on project/program progress, identifying and mitigating risks as needed.

• Facilitate communication and collaboration between the project team, life science industry stakeholders, and other teams within BASE life science.

You bring:

• 5+ years of experience as a technical project/program manager within Regulatory, Clinical, Quality or other GxP areas in the life science industry.

• Successful track record of managing technically complex projects/programs such as software development, implementation of IT systems, data migrations, etc.

• Experience leading technical teams and delivering data driven projects/programs.

• Experience with project management tools such as JIRA, Smartsheet, Microsoft Project etc.

• Experience with Agile project management methodologies such as SAFe.

• Strong communication skills, both in writing, meetings and in presentations.

• Strong verbal and written communication skills in English.

Additionally, the ideal candidate has the following skills/certifications:

• Project Management Professional (PMP) certification

• Experience selling either projects or products to clients.

• Experience working with Veeva Vault, SalesForce or similar technologies.

• Experience working with AI professionally

This position is offered in Denmark and Spain.

Who is BASE life science?

Founded in 2015, BASE life science is a business and technology consulting company working exclusively in life sciences, built on a simple purpose: grow our people, and deliver real impact for our customers.

We don't think AI is a feature you bolt onto existing systems — we think it's the layer through which a life sciences company's strategy actually gets executed, end to end. Most of the industry is still proving AI can do one task at a time, function by function, pilot by pilot. We're building toward something bigger: AI that runs across clinical, regulatory, quality, and commercial work instead of stopping at the edges of a single application.

With headquarters in Denmark and offices across Spain, Switzerland, the UK, Germany, France, Italy, and the US, we work with top-10 pharma and ambitious biotechs alike, and with technology partners including Veeva, Salesforce, IQVIA, Google, AWS, Microsoft, and Amass — turning that belief into deployed, compliant, sellable solutions, not slideware.

Why join BASE Life Science?

At BASE, you work on meaningful, complex challenges at the intersection of technology, science, and business. We trust our people with real responsibility and support them in turning ambition into impact — grounded in five core values: team spirit, trust, openness, ambition, and execution.

• Ambition, encouraged through ownership and continuous learning.

• Execution — we focus on delivering solutions that work in practice.

• Openness — your ideas are heard, challenged constructively, and supported as you grow.

• Flexible ways of working, built on trust, autonomy, and balance.

• The opportunity to shape a practice, not just staff one.

Alongside this, we offer:

• Support for health and wellbeing, covering physical, mental, and social needs

• Flexible ways of working, built on trust, autonomy, and balance

• Ongoing learning and professional development throughout your career

• A modern work setup, with the tools and equipment needed to do great work

• Recognition of performance and impact, linked to contribution and results

• The opportunity to work on challenges that make a meaningful difference for patients and healthcare systems worldwide

Explore our work, values, and people at www.baselifescience.com

Interested?

If you find this position intriguing, don't delay—submit your application in English at your earliest convenience. We are continuously reviewing and assessing all incoming candidates and eagerly await your application.

At BASE Life Science, we value diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. Employment decisions are based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs

**AI Academy Intake - Copenhagen (on-site, full-time)

**At Light, we're redefining how software is built, how it's delivered, and how it works.

We're building organic software. Software that heals itself. Software that adapts to the user and the business. Software that learns and gets better as it's used.

Our starting point is finance. Companies including Legora, Lovable, and Fuse Energy run on Light. We're building towards a platform that understands how each business operates and evolves with it.

The AI Academy

The AI Academy is where Light builds its future leaders for an ever-changing world. It's a small cohort of exceptional early-career people who take an operating process in marketing, sales, finance, partnerships, customer success, product or any other team, and rebuild it so AI agents do the work and humans handle the exceptions. Then they move on to the next one.

We believe roles will increasingly merge, and that cross-functional collaboration and broad knowledge of the business will define high-performing teams. The Academy is built around that:

• Training. You start with a period of training on how to use AI to drive business outcomes: tools, agents, automations, and how to judge their output.

• Several functions at once. You then apply it across several functions, splitting your time between teams such as marketing, sales, finance, partnerships, customer success and product.

• Focus. Over time you move into fewer functions, where you've had the most impact and want to go deepest.

In this role you're a member of Light's AI Academy. You'll undergo specialised AI training and be pushed to use AI in every aspect of your job and to re-think the status quo from first principles.

This training will enable you to effectively build operations and companies at scale. If you aspire to be a future single-person unicorn founder, this is the ideal training ground.

**Who This Is For

**You must meet this requirement: an exceptional level of achievement in a highly competitive endeavour. Work experience in itself is irrelevant, past hires have been 17 years and older. For example:

• A gold medal at the International Mathematical Olympiad (IMO) or International Olympiad in Informatics (IOI)

• Experience at McKinsey QuantumBlack, the Goldman Sachs Special Situations Group or TMT group (regular IBD do not apply), Optiver, Jane Street or similar.

• Having built or sold a company

• Competed in elite-level sport (e.g. a sub-8-hour Ironman, the Olympic Games, or a European or World Championship, football or basketball at highest level)

• A FIDE chess rating of 2,400 or higher (IM level)

• An equivalent level of achievement in another highly competitive endeavour

• Top of class in high-school year

If you're applying with an equivalent achievement, explain the competition or field, your result, and the standard required to achieve it. If you don't have an equivalent level of achievement we encourage you to not apply.

Our bar at Light is high, and this is more than just a job. You will need the curiosity to explore unfamiliar areas, the willingness to go the extra mile to get things right, the discipline to test your assumptions, and the persistence to keep going when your first approach does not work.

We hold two bars: outperforming your metrics, and being kind and supportive of each other. Exceptional ability without kindness is not a fit.

What you'll work on

You'll be in charge of building agentic factories that re-think what is possible across product, marketing, implementation, customer service.

• Rethink work from first principles. Take a process in marketing, sales, finance, partnerships, customer success, or product. Ask what outcome it exists to deliver, and redesign it around what AI now makes possible. Making the old process faster is the easy part.

• Own operations end to end. Take full ownership of processes across finance operations, people operations, and legal and compliance, working directly with the Chief of Staff to CEO. Run them, then rebuild them so agents do the work and nothing falls through the cracks.

• Build the agents and workflows yourself. Identify where manual work can be automated or standardised, and build the solution rather than waiting for someone else to do so.

• Move fast. Ship a first version in hours and iterate several times a day.

• Participate in the AI Academy. Complete the specialised AI training, apply what you learn in every function you work in, and share what worked and what didn't so the rest of the cohort and the teams can adopt it.

• Own projects through delivery. Scope the problem, build the solution, debug regressions, and follow through until the team can rely on what you've shipped.

You'll work alongside exceptional colleagues.

What else we're looking for

• Clear thinking and the ability to explain your decisions, including what you tried and why it didn't work.

• Kindness. You make the people around you better.

How we'll measure success

Your work should produce measurable improvements: 10 to 1,000x output capacity.

What you'll get

• Full-time compensation above the standard market rate.

• Every tool available. We give everyone in the Academy access to all the AI tools on the market, and put you in the environment that will make you a success.

• A role based in our Copenhagen office, working alongside the teams and the AI Academy cohort.

• Ownership from your first day, with a path to owning a function.

How to apply

Send your CV.

Include a link to, or a description of, something you've built. Tell us what it does, which parts you built yourself, where it failed, and how you fixed it. Then explain why you want to join the AI Academy at Light.

We want to understand how you think, what you can build, and what you're ready to take on next.

Light is an equal opportunity employer.

You will keep the processes running, improve them where it makes a difference, and represent them in audits and inspections. **

**About Zealand Pharma A/S

**Zealand Pharma A/S (Nasdaq: ZEAL) is a biotechnology company focused on advancing medicines for obesity and metabolic health. Combining more than 25 years of peptide R&D expertise with a proprietary data platform that leverages advanced data-driven and AI/ML approaches, Zealand Pharma aims to lead a new era in obesity and metabolic health. To date, more than ten Zealand Pharma-invented drug candidates have entered clinical development, of which two products have reached the market and three candidates are in late-stage development. The Company has collaborations with global pharmaceutical and biotechnology partners for research, development, and commercialization. Founded in 1998, Zealand Pharma is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, with a U.S. presence in Boston, Massachusetts. Learn more at www.zealandpharma.com.

**The Impact You'll Make

**As our new Senior Heat Plate Design Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the future of Danfoss' gasketed plate heat exchanger (GPHE) portfolio.

As a senior member of the GPHE New Product Development team, you will drive the development of complete product solutions from concept through production release, helping deliver products that combine strong performance, reliability, quality, and cost competitiveness.

Beyond delivering innovative products, you will contribute your expertise to strengthening the team's technical capabilities. You will act as a mentor and sparring partner for colleagues across development projects, sharing knowledge, supporting complex technical problem solving, and helping the team build on proven engineering practices and lessons learned.

This role is ideal for an experienced product development engineer who enjoys combining hands-on engineering with technical depth and who is motivated by creating solutions that improve energy efficiency and support sustainable applications worldwide.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**As part of our GPHE New Product Development team, you will lead the development of complete GPHE products from concept through launch and industrialization.

**Key Responsibilities Include

**

• Lead the development of GPHE products from concept creation through validation, industrialization, and successful production release

• Translate customer, market, and business needs into robust product requirements and technical solutions

• Develop and optimize GPHE product architectures to achieve performance, reliability, manufacturability, compliance, and cost targets

• Drive design activities including simulation, prototyping, testing, validation, DFMEA, technical risk management, and problem-solving throughout the product lifecycle

• Provide technical guidance and mentoring to colleagues while collaborating across global cross-functional teams to ensure successful project execution and knowledge sharing.

In your day-to-day work, you will partner closely with specialists in thermal, hydraulic, and mechanical engineering while contributing to technical reviews, design validation activities, and continuous product improvement initiatives.

**What We're Looking For

**To be successful in this role, you will bring a strong combination of engineering expertise, product development experience, and a collaborative mindset.

**Essential Qualifications

**

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Thermal Engineering, Product Development, or a related engineering discipline

• Significant experience developing mechanical products from concept through production release and industrialization, preferably within heat exchangers, pressure equipment, industrial products, or similar engineered solutions

• Strong experience with mechanical product design and 3D CAD development, including sheet metal or formed component design

• Proven ability to independently drive complex technical development activities and influence engineering decisions across cross-functional projects

• Strong communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to mentor colleagues and work effectively in a global engineering environment

**Preferred Qualifications

**Experience with GPHE products, thermal systems, heat transfer technologies, simulation-driven development, DFMEA, design validation, and design-for-manufacturing principles would be considered an advantage.

We are looking for an experienced engineer who enjoys combining deep technical expertise with collaboration and knowledge sharing. You naturally take ownership of complex engineering challenges, help develop those around you, and maintain a holistic view of product development while balancing performance, manufacturability, quality, and cost.

**What You'll Get From Us

**At Danfoss, you'll help engineer a better future by contributing to solutions that make a real difference around the world.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to work with advanced heat transfer technologies and develop products that improve energy efficiency across a wide range of industrial applications. You will collaborate with experts in thermal engineering, virtual engineering, laboratory testing, manufacturing, and quality, gaining exposure across the full product development lifecycle while helping shape the next generation of GPHE solutions.

We'll support your career growth with mentoring, learning opportunities, and access to global career paths.

You'll have the flexibility, autonomy, and support you need to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance.

You'll be part of an inclusive workplace where people of all backgrounds are respected, valued, and empowered to succeed.

You'll receive a competitive rewards package that includes benefits such as an annual bonus, paid vacation, pension plans, health insurance, and more. As a global company, these benefits vary by country and contract.

**Ready to Make a Difference?

**If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you! Apply now to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us.

We expect all employees to live and breathe our behaviors: to act with humility and build trust; lead with transparency; deliver with focus, and drive ownership –always with unyielding integrity.

Our total rewards are designed to unlock your ambition by giving you the boost and flexibility you need to turn your ideas into world-changing realities. We are looking for a Financial Controller to lead the operational and analytical work behind our monthly close, group consolidation, project controlling and control environment of a fast-growing energy trading and technology group – and to rebuild them AI-first, so our numbers are faster, more reliable and ready for scale.

Why this role matters

Hybrid Greentech is scaling fast as a VPP, BRP and electricity retailer across Denmark, and Northern Europe. Energy trading means large and volatile daily revenue, cost and cash transactions – so quality , accuracy and liquidity control are not back-office topics; they decide how fast we can grow. This role exists to give management, the board and investors numbers they can trust, on time, and to build controls and automation that scale with the business rather than with headcount. The same discipline is needed in our consultancy arm, where technical consultants deliver advisory and EPC management projects: clear project economics, timely invoicing and early warning when a project drifts.

The role

As Financial Controller, you report to our Finance Manager and work closely with the CFO and our accountant in a small, hands-on finance team. You lead the operational and analytical work within the financial steering, reporting and finance and business analytics; running the month-end close, the consolidation of our group entities in Denmark and abroad, balance sheet reconciliations, project controlling and the day-to-day operation of our internal controls. This is an individual contributor role with high ownership and direct visibility towards management.

You will work in close collaboration with our settlement team, project managers and business owners to ensure adequate financial steering and reporting, partner with our accountant on more complex accounting topics, and work across trading, portfolio management, commercial and engineering. We are a tech-first company with high AI adoption, and we expect you to work that way too: AI tools, scripting and automation are your default approach to removing manual work from close, reconciliation and reporting – combined with the judgement to know when a number needs a human review.

What you will do

• Lead and execute the monthly close and group consolidation, including account mapping, intercompany eliminations, reconciliations and variance analysis, and prepare the monthly financial and business review for the CFO, management and the board.

• Set up and run project controlling – project budgets, hours and utilisation, work in progress, milestone and fixed-fee revenue recognition and timely invoicing – giving project managers and business owners clear steering on margin, estimate-to-complete and cash.

• Automate and rebuild our reporting flow – from ERP trial balances to consolidated P&L, balance sheet and cash flow – using AI tools, scripting and data pipelines, replacing manual spreadsheet steps with controlled, repeatable and documented processes.

• Operate and strengthen our internal controls within the framework set by the Finance Manager, including segregation of duties, payment and bank authorisations and documented business procedures, and drive follow-up on auditor recommendations.

• In close collaboration with Settlement, ensure trading-related balances – settlement, imbalance costs, customer prepayments and deposits, and collateral posted to TSOs, DSOs and exchanges – are correctly recognized, invoiced and reconciled

• Support cash and liquidity forecasting and management with the Finance Manager and CFO, including rolling cash forecasts, collateral and trading risk capital tracking, and early warning on cash exposure.

• Prepare and analyse the annual budget and monthly forecast updates for the Finance Manager and CFO, maintaining our driver-based budget model and following up on budget-versus-actual deviations with business owners.

• Handle key accounting areas such as revenue recognition and accruals, capitalisation of development projects, grant periodisation and month-end cost accruals, collaborating with our accountant on more complex accounting topics.

• Support in the year-end close and audit for all group entities, including annual reports, tax specifications and intercompany agreements, in close collaboration with Finance Manager and our external auditors.

• Work closely with our Settlement team and business owners to ensure adequate financial steering and reporting – turning data into insight on gross profit by revenue stream, cost of execution and unit economics, and building dashboards that let the business self-serve.

What you bring

Experience and skills (Required)

• 5+ years of experience as a controller, in audit or in a group finance role, ideally in a multi-entity set-up.

• A relevant degree in accounting, finance or economics (e.g. cand.merc., HD-R or cand.merc.aud.).

• Proven hands-on experience running month-end close, consolidation and year-end audit under the Danish Financial Statements Act (Årsregnskabsloven)

• Hands-on experience with ERP systems, preferably e-conomic

• Solid understanding of balance sheet accounting, revenue recognition, capitalised development costs, accruals and intercompany transactions.

• Experience with project controlling – budgets, work in progress, utilisation and project margin follow-up – ideally in a consultancy, engineering, Trading or EPC business.

• A genuine AI-first way of working: you use AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT or Copilot daily and can show concrete examples of finance processes you have automated (e.g. with Python, SQL, Power Query, APIs or low-code tools).

• Strong Excel and financial modelling skills combined with a structured, control-minded approach and high attention to detail.

• The ability to work independently in a fast-paced scale-up, prioritise under pressure and explain financial matters clearly to non-finance colleagues.

• Language: English (required); Danish

Nice to have

• Experience from energy trading, utilities, commodities or financial services – e.g. settlement, collateral, imbalance or margin processes.

• Experience with e-conomic, time registration or PSA tools, ERP migration to a more scalable platform, and BI tools such as Power BI.

• Experience with public grant-funded projects, transfer pricing or building internal controls in a growth company.

• A background from a Big 4 or mid-tier audit firm.

What we offer

• Real responsibility: the chance to improve how close, controls and reporting are run in a scaling energy trading group – not just maintain them.

• An AI-first workplace where you get the tools and the mandate to automate, experiment and rethink how finance is done, working closely with our CFO, trading and tech teams with exposure to board and investor reporting.

• Competitive compensation and performance-based incentives.

• A collaborative environment with short decision lines, high trust, and strong cross-functional execution.

• The opportunity to work with forward-looking customers and partners driving electrification and the green transition in Northern Europe.

Ready to apply?

Ready to build an AI-first finance function for a company where every megawatt-hour traded must be settled, reconciled and controlled? If you combine accounting rigour with a builder's mindset, we would love to hear from you.

Deadline

Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis until 10 December. We reserve the right to close this vacancy earlier if a suitable candidate is identified and accepted.

About Hybrid Greentech

Hybrid Greentech helps Battery Energy Storage Systems and flexible assets perform across their full lifecycle, from project readiness to real-time multi-market trading. We are a vertically integrated VPP, BRP and retailer. We combine analytics, EPC management, asset integration and automated trading to turn flexibility into reliable value for the grid and for asset owners. We are a diverse, international team of 45+ based in Høje Taastrup, building technology that makes 100% renewable energy workable in practice.

atNorth is a leading Nordic data center company providing cost-effective, scalable high-density colocation and built-to-suit services to industry-leading organizations across Iceland, Sweden, Finland, and Denmark.

With sustainability at our core, our data centers run on renewable energy and are designed according to circular economy principles. Through innovative design, power efficiency, and intelligent operations, we deliver reliable, secure, and high-performance infrastructure.

Headquartered in Reykjavik, Iceland, atNorth operates eight data centers across the Nordics, with additional sites under development in Finland, Denmark, Sweden and Norway.

We combine world-class technology with a people-first culture built on collaboration, ownership, and trust, empowering our teams to grow, take responsibility, and make a real impact.

By joining our international team, you will help shape the future of sustainable digital infrastructure.

**Strategy Manager at atNorth

We are looking for a Strategy Manager to help define and drive atNorth's future growth and strategic direction. This is a highly visible role working closely with the CEO, Executive Committee, Board, and senior business leaders to identify opportunities, solve complex business challenges, and ensure atNorth remains at the forefront of the rapidly evolving Nordic data center market.

Focusing heavily on strategy development, you will lead analyses, challenge assumptions, identify opportunities, and develop recommendations that influence critical decisions across growth, power, sustainability, commercial development, and corporate strategy. Reporting to the Director of Strategy and working as part of our Strategy team, you will collaborate closely with our existing Strategy Manager, combining strategic thinking with practical execution to turn ambitious goals into tangible outcomes.

This is a unique opportunity to influence the direction of one of the fastest-growing data center platforms in the Nordics. You will have direct exposure to executive leadership and play a key role in decisions that shape the future of sustainable digital infrastructure across the region. You'll join a collaborative, international team where curiosity, ownership, and impact are valued, and where your work will directly contribute to atNorth's continued success.

**Key responsibilities:

**

• Lead the development and refinement of atNorth's corporate strategy, ensuring alignment with long-term business objectives.

• Keep a pulse on market trends, customer demand, competitor activity, technology developments, and broader industry dynamics to identify risks and opportunities.

• Translate market insights and business intelligence into strategic recommendations that support growth, competitiveness, and long-term value creation.

• Partner with executives, business leaders, and functional teams to evaluate strategic initiatives and priorities across the organisation.

• Support strategic planning, decision-making, and Board preparation activities alongside the Executive Committee and senior leadership team.

• Lead strategic projects and cross-functional initiatives from concept through implementation.

• Develop compelling business cases, market assessments, and strategic presentations for senior stakeholders.

• Support the development of power, sustainability, commercial, and geographic growth strategies that are critical to atNorth's long-term success.

• Engage with internal and external stakeholders to gather insights that inform strategic planning and decision-making.

• Act as a trusted advisor and thought partner to senior leadership on strategic opportunities and challenges.

**Your profile:

**

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, Strategy, Industrial Management, or a related field.

• 5+ years of experience in corporate strategy, management consulting, business development, strategic planning, or related disciplines.

• Demonstrated experience developing business strategies and influencing strategic decisions at a senior level.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with the ability to turn complex information into actionable recommendations.

• Experience presenting to executive leadership teams, boards, or senior decision-makers.

• Excellent stakeholder management skills and the ability to influence without direct authority.

• Strong communication and presentation skills with the ability to engage audiences ranging from operational teams to executives.

• Professional proficiency in English.

• Experience within the data center, energy, utilities, infrastructure, technology, or other capital-intensive industries is considered a strong advantage.

**About the atNorth Culture

**We believe that sustainable success starts with the wellbeing of our people. For us, an open, transparent, and inclusive culture is more than a priority, it is the core of how we lead and innovate.

We don’t just talk about culture; we nurture it. Through regular one-to-one engagements and monthly wellbeing surveys, we listen carefully to our teams, ensuring that every voice is heard and every opportunity for improvement is embraced.

We recognize that innovation and collaboration thrive where people feel truly connected, which is why we come together each week to share ideas, strengthen relationships, and nurture a sense of belonging, sometimes over a simple breakfast and good conversation.

At atNorth, we are building a community where you can do your best work and shape a sustainable future together.

**Use your skills to revolutionize HR with Team Spirit and Innovation at NTT DATA

**Are you ready to be a part of a team that is reshaping the world of HR, making a real impact for our clients? As our new Employee Central consultant, you will get to combine leadership, technical expertise and business understanding with your genuine mentor mentality.

**A Close-Knit team – and a One-Stop-Shop for Pioneering HR Solutions

**Will you give us the opportunity to let you shine?

**At NTT DATA Business Solutions, we believe our strength lies in our diversity. At Cellerator, the partnerships you will build make life-changing therapies possible. We are a philanthropic organisation founded and funded by the Novo Nordisk Foundation, dedicated to turning cell-based therapies into treatments that reach the people who need them.

About the role

As our Business Development Specialist, you will turn interest from biotechs, spin-outs, academic groups and pharma into well-qualified programmes and signed agreements. You will assess scientific and strategic fit, guide clients through intake and due diligence, and shape proposals and deals. This is consultative business development, not hard selling. Just as importantly, you will design the commercial engine itself: the client journey, funnel, stage gates, CRM, pitch and pricing.

You will join a supportive team that values collaboration as we build the site together. If you are excited to shape how a new cell therapy facility partners with academia and industry from day one, this is the opportunity for you.

What you'll do

• Drive the funnel from first contact to signed agreement and a smooth handover to the Program Director and Project Manager, managing several opportunities at a time

• Assess the scientific, technical and strategic fit of programmes together with the Program Director and our Process Development and GMP experts, and lead intake and due diligence

• Build proposals and deals, including scope, assumptions, pricing input and timelines, and take them through contracting (NDA, MSA, SOW) with Legal and Finance

• Design and continuously improve our sales process and client journey: pipeline, lead criteria, stage gates, workshops, pitch materials and pricing models

• Own pipeline management and CRM, and work with Communications on campaigns, events, content and the website, so that marketing feeds the funnel

• Build long-term relationships with founders, academic teams, biotechs, pharma, investors and ecosystem partners, and represent Cellerator at events in the Nordics and Europe

What you'll bring

• An MSc in life sciences or a related field, with a strong understanding of drug development. Experience within cell or gene therapy is highly valued (PhD is an advantage)

• Around 8–10 years of professional experience, including solid experience in commercial or business development roles in drug development – ideally from a CDMO, CRO or biotech.

• The scientific credibility to understand cell therapy programmes and translate technical considerations into commercial discussions

• Experience working with structured sales processes, funnels or client journeys, combined with the ability and motivation to help build and improve our commercial setup.

• Hands-on experience with CRM, structured pipeline management and contracts such as MSAs, SOWs and change orders (SAP experience and an understanding of demand generation and marketing are an advantage)

• Excellent English, written and spoken (Danish and a network in the Nordic or European cell therapy ecosystem are an advantage)

• An entrepreneurial, consultative people person who builds trust quickly, is credible with scientists and executives alike, and is comfortable designing structure in an organisation that is still taking shape

Interested?

Send your CV and a short note about why this role interests you. We review applications on an ongoing basis, so do not wait for the deadline.

Life at Cellerator

We’re building something meaningful from the ground up. If you thrive in complexity, value pragmatic solutions over perfect theory, and want your work to directly influence how advanced therapies reach patients, you’ll feel at home here.

Built with you, not before you. We’re a scale-up, so our processes, culture, and ways of working are still taking shape. You won’t inherit a rigid playbook—you’ll help create it.

Work well, sustainably. We take work–life balance seriously and aim for a supportive, enjoyable workplace. Good science happens when people feel trusted, supported, and able to do their best work.

Flat by design. We work across teams rather than in silos. Whether you’re collaborating with GMP production, academic partners, or leadership, your perspective matters. We prioritise partnership over hierarchy.

Backed, but independent. The Novo Nordisk Foundation provides the stability and credibility to deliver on our mission. At the same time, our culture and direction are distinctly our own, and we move with the pace and spirit of a scale-up.

Are you passionate about supporting colleagues offshore? Do you want to work in the green offshore wind industry where your skills and expertise will help secure a sustainable future based on renewable energy? Then you might be the Crewing Coordinator we are looking for.

Join us and become part of a team where your contribution matters, your ideas are valued and we set the standard together.

**Come work with us!

**By becoming a Cadeler employee, you will be part of a rapidly growing company with a diverse and energetic team. We offer an exciting position focused on delivering excellence in the face of interesting new challenges, within a positive and rewarding work environment in an international company with great development possibilities.

Cadeler has a global presence, with offices in Copenhagen, Vejle, Norwich, Rotterdam, and Taipei, alongside colleagues working offshore aboard our fleet of Wind Farm Installation Vessels (WFIVs).

Meet some of our colleagues here: https://www.cadeler.com/career

Please be aware, that if hired for the position the title will be Crewing Logistics Coordinator.

If you have any questions regarding the position or practical matters, please contact peopleandculture@cadeler.com.

Do you understand pension administration and want to explore how the technology behind it works? Or are you a developer who wants to understand the pension processes your software supports? Join Keylane and help operate and improve Plexus across our private Keylane Cloud and Microsoft Azure.

**Key About Your Role

**You will connect functional knowledge of pension administration with technical application management and a serious interest in automating the work we do. By understanding both the business process, the technical side off the application and the application itself, you will help colleagues and customers identify why issues occur and how to resolve them.

You will:

• Investigate Plexus issues by tracing pension back-office processes through application behaviour, logs and SQL database queries.

• Work with SQL databases and Red Hat Linux environments to diagnose application and data issues, involving database and platform specialists where needed.

• Support Plexus environments hosted on our private Keylane Cloud and on Azure, working with the teams responsible for each platform.

• Coordinate application releases and maintenance, and verify that affected pension processes work correctly after changes.

• Translate functional problems into clear technical findings and explain the business impact of technical issues.

• Use scripts and practical documentation to make recurring support tasks easier and more reliable.

• Take a senior role in complex investigations, share your knowledge and help colleagues develop their approach to problem solving.

**Key About Your Team

**You will work with colleagues supporting Plexus and collaborate with functional specialists, developers and cloud operations teams. Together, you will connect the details of pension administration with the technical work needed to support the application.

**Requirements

**We welcome two professional backgrounds:

• Functional experience with a pension back-office system, combined with a serious interest in technology and a willingness to learn how applications, databases and operating environments work.

• Software development experience, combined with an interest in the business side of pension administration and a willingness to learn how pension processes are supported in Plexus.

Whichever route you bring, you can demonstrate the judgement and ownership expected of a senior colleague. You can work independently, recognize when specialist input is needed and help others move an investigation forward.

You also bring:

• Ideally 5 + years' experience in the field

• A structured approach to investigation, with the ability to connect business symptoms, application behavior and data.

• The ability to explain complex issues clearly in English and work effectively with technical and functional colleagues.

• An interest in hands-on application support and in developing your SQL and Red Hat Linux skills.

• Experience with SQL databases, Linux, scripting or cloud-hosted applications is an advantage. Familiarity with Azure or Plexus is welcome.

You do not need to arrive with equal depth in pension administration and technology. You should be ready to build the connection between them and apply your experience to real customer situations.

**Using AI

**You use AI-assisted tools with care when exploring technical questions, preparing scripts or documenting solutions. You review and test their output, protect customer information and remain accountable for the quality and security of your work.

**Other

**Please send your application with CV via our website. Applications are evaluated continuously.

A criminal record and reference check are part of the application process. Each employee within Keylane must follow training on information security and irrespective to the role basic information security responsibilities apply.

**Benefits

**

• A flat and informal organization with a professional and supportive working environment.

• A profit share.

• Inclusion days where you decide when to hold your public holidays.

• Five weeks of vacation and five Keylane days.

• A pension scheme where 13.25% is paid by Keylane and the individual contribution is 3%.

• Flexibility in the working environment. We offer a combination of working from home and from the office. We value seeing colleagues in person to stay connected and collaborate effectively.

• The Danish office is located a 10-minute walk from Islands Brygge Metro station.

• We believe that strong employee relations are key to maintaining well-being in the workplace. To support this, we offer a variety of social activities that all employees can participate in, such as yoga, padel tennis, running, outdoor bathing, and fitness in the basement.

• Salary: For this role, the Monthly Base Salary ranges from 50.000 - 60.000 (DKK), corresponding to the level of the position. The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate's skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience

At Autorola Solutions, we're helping transform how the global automotive industry operates through digital solutions, technology and business process expertise.

We're looking for a Senior Business System Consultant to take a leading role in designing and delivering complex software solutions across customer engagements. Combining strong business process understanding with deep solution expertise, you'll translate business requirements into scalable, high-quality system solutions and take ownership of the technical approach from initial analysis through configuration, implementation and final validation.

As a senior member of the team, you'll be a trusted advisor to customers and an important sparring partner for Project Management Consultants, Software Development (ASYS), Product Management, Sales and our subsidiaries. You'll help shape solution designs, guide technical decisions, identify risks and opportunities, and ensure that customer needs are translated into practical, sustainable solutions that create lasting business value.

If you're passionate about solving complex business challenges, advising customers at a strategic and operational level, and driving high-quality software implementations, we'd love to hear from you.

**About Us

**The Autorola Group is a global leader in online vehicle remarketing, automotive IT solutions and business intelligence for the used vehicle market. Through Autorola Marketplace, Autorola Solutions and Indicata, we help manufacturers, leasing companies, fleet owners and dealers buy, sell and manage vehicles more efficiently using technology, data and digital solutions.

**Lead the design and delivery of smart, scalable solutions

**As Senior Business System Consultant, you'll take ownership of the technical solution throughout the customer engagement. Working in close partnership with a Project Management Consultant, who is responsible for the client relationship, project scope, planning and overall delivery, you'll lead the solution design and ensure that business requirements are translated into robust, scalable and maintainable system solutions.

You'll bring senior-level expertise to complex customer scenarios, advising on business processes, product capabilities and solution alternatives. You'll challenge requirements where appropriate, identify opportunities to leverage standard functionality, and help determine when configuration is sufficient and when further product development is needed.

Your role will extend beyond individual implementations. You'll contribute to improving our solution delivery practices, establish and promote best practices, share knowledge across the team and act as a trusted technical and functional sparring partner for colleagues. Where relevant, you'll also engage directly with customer business teams to ensure that solutions support real operational workflows and deliver the intended business outcomes.

Success means more than delivering a configured system. It means making sound solution decisions, reducing implementation complexity, ensuring consistent quality and helping customers realise lasting value from Autorola's software solutions.

**What You'll Be Doing

**

• Lead the analysis and translation of complex customer requirements and business processes into effective, scalable solution designs.

• Take ownership of the technical and functional solution approach throughout customer engagements, from initial assessment to implementation and validation.

• Design, configure and build Autorola software solutions, ensuring that they meet business needs and align with product capabilities, architecture and standards.

• Act as a trusted advisor to customers, challenging assumptions, clarifying requirements and recommending solutions that balance business value, feasibility and long-term sustainability.

• Provide senior solution input during project scoping, including technical effort estimates, dependency assessments, risk identification and evaluation of alternative approaches.

• Work closely with Project Management Consultants to ensure that solution decisions support realistic plans, predictable delivery and successful customer outcomes.

• Assess the fit between customer-specific requirements and standard product functionality, identifying when configuration, process adaptation or new development is the most appropriate approach.

• Collaborate with Product Management and Software Development (ASYS) to shape, clarify and qualify enhancement requests and development requirements.

• Take responsibility for solution quality, including configuration standards, test planning, validation and the resolution of functional and technical issues.

• Support customers' operational teams in adopting new solutions and ensuring that implemented functionality works effectively in their day-to-day business.

• Identify opportunities to improve implementation efficiency, solution consistency and reuse through templates, standards, guidelines and proven practices.

• Act as a senior sparring partner and knowledge resource for colleagues, supporting the development of solution expertise and promoting knowledge sharing across the organisation.

• Contribute to the continuous improvement of our consulting methods, delivery processes and collaboration across Business System Consulting, Project Management, Product Management and Software Development.

**Who are we looking for?

**We're looking for an experienced Senior Business System Consultant who combines strong business acumen with substantial solution consulting experience, sound technical judgement and the ability to guide customers and colleagues through complex implementation challenges.

You can move confidently between business processes, product capabilities and technical considerations. You know how to challenge requirements constructively, make informed trade-offs and turn complexity into clear, actionable solution designs.

**You likely have:

**

• Several years of relevant experience in business systems consulting, solution consulting, software implementation, business process consultancy or a similar client-facing role.

• A proven track record of leading or taking significant ownership of complex system implementations and solution designs.

• Strong experience translating complex business requirements into practical, scalable and maintainable software solutions.

• Extensive experience with system configuration, functional design, testing and implementation quality.

• The ability to assess solution alternatives, evaluate technical and functional trade-offs, and make well-founded recommendations.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, combined with a structured and pragmatic approach to decision-making.

• The confidence to advise customers, challenge assumptions and communicate complex topics clearly to both business and technical stakeholders.

• Experience collaborating with Project Management, Software Development, Product Management and other cross-functional teams.

• The ability to identify implementation risks, dependencies and opportunities early, helping create more predictable and efficient delivery.

• A continuous improvement mindset and an interest in developing shared standards, best practices and team capabilities.

• The ability to balance individual customer needs with standard functionality, product consistency and long-term maintainability.

• A willingness to travel internationally for customer engagements when required.

Experience with enterprise software, IT consulting, Agile environments or the automotive industry is an advantage. Experience mentoring colleagues or contributing to the development of consulting practices is also beneficial.

**What Success Looks Like

**Within your first 12–18 months, you'll have:

• Established yourself as a trusted senior advisor to customers on complex business processes, solution design and product capabilities.

• Successfully led the solution design and technical delivery of complex customer implementations.

• Built a strong understanding of Autorola's products, business processes, technical capabilities and strategic priorities.

• Helped Project Management Consultants scope customer engagements more accurately through sound technical assessments, effort estimates and early risk identification.

• Improved solution quality, consistency and maintainability through clear design principles and well-founded technical and functional decisions.

• Strengthened collaboration between customers, Business System Consulting, Project Management, Software Development (ASYS), Product Management, Sales and our subsidiaries.

• Contributed to more efficient implementations through reusable solutions, improved templates, standards and best practices.

• Shared your experience and expertise to strengthen the capabilities of the wider consulting team.

• Helped customers adopt their solutions successfully and realise measurable value in their day-to-day operations.

**Why join Autorola Group?

**Autorola Group is a global company with more than 850 employees across 20 subsidiaries in Europe, Latin America and Asia-Pacific.

At Autorola Solutions, you'll join an international environment where project management, business process expertise and software development come together to solve complex challenges for leading automotive companies.

As a Senior Business System Consultant, you'll have a significant influence on how we design and deliver customer solutions. You'll work across organisational and geographical boundaries, collaborate with experienced colleagues and help shape the standards, methods and practices that support our continued growth.

We also offer pension and health insurance, social and company events, a great lunch arrangement, access to a fitness room and a lively Friday bar.

**Want to join the team?

**We're looking to fill the position as soon as possible. Please note that this description reflects our ideal candidate profile. We strongly believe in inclusion and diversity and encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every requirement.

Applications and CVs will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, and the advertisement may be removed once the right candidate has been found.

If you have any questions about the position, feel free to contact Christian Gless, Tech Talent Acquisition Partner, at csg@autorola.com.

jobs.occupation: Medical Scientific Advisor Gyn GU GI (GGG) Denmark – Nordic Marketing Company
jobs.description:
_Are you driven to transform cancer care by turning science into real-world change? In this role, you will connect cutting-edge evidence with clinical practice, helping physicians make well informed and confident decisions that improve outcomes for people living with cancer and those who care for them. Your work will accelerate the adoption of appropriate therapies by removing diagnostic and pathway bottlenecks through credible, balanced scientific engagement.

_Our AstraZeneca Nordic Marketing Company employs around 550 people and has offices located in Copenhagen, Stockholm, Oslo, and Espoo. AstraZeneca Nordic is a recognized leader in its core therapy areas and aims to improve the lives of millions of people. This is an area where you are free to be more – you are encouraged to challenge traditional ways and test your curiosity. We drive innovative science, deliver key launches, build close collaboration and partnerships within health care.

As the therapy-area medical expert for your country, you will lead in-country scientific engagement and execute medical strategy with precision. You will collaborate closely with the Therapeutic Area Lead and country medical leadership, leveraging Nordic alignment to amplify impact. Using digital and AI-enabled tools to strengthen preparation, literature synthesis and insight capture—while upholding scientific integrity and compliance, you will turn external learning into action. Can you see yourself building trusted partnerships that shape launches and elevate standards of care?

This role is field based.

**Accountabilities

**

• Scientific Engagement: Develop and execute the country scientific engagement plan, building trusted relationships with experts, societies, investigators and healthcare stakeholders.

• Scientific Exchange: Lead balanced, non-promotional scientific dialogue, respond compliantly to unsolicited requests and manage advisory boards in line with procedures.

• Insight Generation: Identify pathway bottlenecks, diagnostic gaps and adoption barriers; translate insights into recommendations for strategy, evidence generation, launches and access.

• Launch & Transforming Care: Support launch readiness, medical education, scientific narrative development, objection handling and initiatives that address healthcare-system needs.

• Evidence & Clinical Trials: Identify local evidence gaps, support RWE and externally sponsored research, and contribute to clinical-trial feasibility, site engagement and delivery.

• Market Access Support: Provide scientific input to HTA, formulary and protocol submissions, guidelines and appropriate-use initiatives.

• Governance & Internal Enablement: Ensure compliance with local codes, SOPs and ethical standards; support medical review, pharmacovigilance and inspection readiness.

• Medical Expertise & Collaboration: Act as a therapy-area subject-matter expert, deliver scientific training and collaborate effectively with cross-functional and Nordic teams.

**Essential Skills And Experience

**

• Advanced life-sciences degree, such as MSc, PharmD, MD or PhD.

• Proven deliverables for the experience in the relevant therapy area and scientific stakeholder engagement.

• Strong ability to generate insights, synthesize evidence and translate findings into action.

• Understanding of clinical trials, evidence generation and medical support for market access.

• Excellent scientific communication, influencing and cross-functional collaboration skills.

• Ability to use digital and AI-enabled tools with scientific rigor, compliance and sound judgment.

• Valid driver’s license as this is a field-based position.

• Fluency in the local language and English.

**Desirable Skills And Experience

**

• PhD, MD, MBA or other relevant advanced qualifications.

• Proven successful pharmaceutical Medical Affairs experience, particularly in pre-launch or launch environments.

• Proven impactful collaborations in clinical trials, RWE or externally sponsored research.

• Experience supporting HTA, formulary or protocol submissions.

• Eligibility for local material certification.

• Proficiency with analytics, insight platforms and relevant management systems.

**Inclusion & Diversity

**We are proud to have a unique workplace culture that inspires innovation and collaboration! Here, employees are empowered to express diverse perspectives - and are made to feel valued, energized and rewarded for their ideas and creativity.

**Why AstraZeneca

**Join a team where science and strategy come together to change how cancer is treated. You will collaborate closely with clinicians, biostatisticians, data scientists, market access experts and more—often in the same room—turning evidence into practice that improves every step of the patient journey. We empower bold ideas, learn fast from what works, and back ambition with support, valuing kindness alongside high standards. With a strong and diverse oncology pipeline, opportunities to shape real-world evidence, and a culture of openness and learning, your expertise will directly influence clinical decisions and accelerate meaningful progress for patients, science and society.

**So, What Is Next

**If you’re ready to use your scientific voice to shape oncology care and see your insights turn into better outcomes, send your application and take the next step today!

Welcome with your application, in English, latest **by the 22nd of November 2026

Technical Superintendent

Position description

Introduction

Scandlines is looking for a Technical Superintendent who enjoys working on projects and has a keen interest in the continuous energy optimization of our vessels.

Job description

As our new Technical Superintendent, you will be responsible for the maintenance and compliance of two vessels. You will also play a key role in achieving Scandlines’ strategic ambitions and ensuring that operations meet our internal key performance indicators (KPIs).

To succeed in this role, you will need to maintain a clear overview of your responsibilities, collaborate effectively with colleagues and take a solution-oriented approach to challenges.

Area of responsiblities

• Ensure that the vessels remain compliant

• Coordinate onboard maintenance planning, including the scheduling of maintenance work on the vessels

• Facilitate Scandlines' strategy

• Assist with project-related technical solutions

• Handle various ad hoc tasks

Competencies

An educational background as a marine engineer, dual officer or naval architect

Solid experience in a maritime environment, including planning and scheduling vessel maintenance and contributing to technical projects.

Knowledge of ship classification and the rules of the Danish Maritime Authority

Personal skills

• You enjoy working independently and keep your eyes on the goal

• You have excellent communication skills and are fluent in both written and spoken English

• You have a structured way of working and can manage different projects simultaneously

• You enjoy sharing knowledge with your colleagues and are curious about new technology that can support Scandlines’ green agenda

Deadline

12/12/2026

Additional information

Additional information

Join us in an exciting and challenging role in a dynamic, international organisation with high ambitions.

We offer a competitive salary based on your qualifications, along with a range of attractive employee benefits, including a pension scheme, health insurance, a staff canteen, additional days off, and various discount schemes.

We review applications and conduct interviews on an ongoing basis and reserve the right to close the position once the right candidate has been identified.
